'''obi-wan-wonder Hoth heaven''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[obi-wan-wonder]]
* '''Published:''' 20 August 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 MPG obi-wan-wonder LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck has a rebel base at hoth with great effects to strengthen my defenses. It has powerful characters and many good opportunities to force drain.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

I use starting interuppts to get some effects into play so i can get EBO set up in no time. I protect the hoth north ridge so imperials can't get into hoth and i force drain as much as i can with interrupts ad effects so my opponent doesn't have any time to react.
